# Synthetic capsule checklist
## Disconnected practice bench
Only on the inert rehearsal unit:

- [x] Latch the saffron port before venting.
  - Example: engage the dummy catch.
- [ ] Vent the silver capsule after latching the port.
  - Limitation: use inert test gas only.
- Caveat: never connect live machinery.
